comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record places and spot-welds a nickel strip across four battery cells.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate bends a wire, inserts one blade, and withdraws tool and wire together; record aligns a strip and sequentially makes paired probe contacts with a welder.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intact selective removal; record requires aligned strip placement, four weld contacts, tool return, and safe final stillness.
comparison.reason: The record tests material placement and repeated welding-tool contacts, not latch release.
